title: Q1 — Who used the screwdriver first?

question.annotator_reason: Saw Alice tightening screws with a screwdriver

fine_caption_window.text: I glance at Shure and keep walking while holding the small tripod. "Oh, no. We're not that rich yet. We can only rely on this villa, or trust Beijing Electric," I say. Katrina walks toward the windowsill. I reach back for the small tripod, bring it in front of me, walk to the desk, and stop. "Right," I say. Shure says, "Thank you." "Alright, you guys…"
fine_caption_window.note: Episodic captions describe many speech acts and small motions around the rack-setup scene but do NOT directly say who first used the screwdriver — this is why the 3-axis baseline was misled.

why_spatial_won: Episodic captures speech and small motions but never tags the first user of the screwdriver. The spatial layer made it concrete: the camera wearer was BEHIND Alice — placing Alice in the natural position to be doing close-up screw work. Combined with the episodic keyword 'tighten screws', the agent committed to Alice.
pattern: When the episodic layer is dense on dialogue but silent on who-touched-what, the spatial layer's relative-position triples (behind, next_to, in_front_of) act as a tie-breaker among candidates.
